deficitDamage.semantics: v0.11 excess-unit damage: nearest-19-to-Core protected, remaining units damaged farthest-to-nearest by Manhattan distance, ties by ascending raw UUID
deficitDamage.note: official docs site still shows v0.10 (Core damage); v0.11 changelog + GPT verification support excess-unit semantics. Confirm with real events once population >= 20 with deficit occurs
